Not worth the time to download. This app, while I’m sure it’s well meaning, isn’t worth the time to download. Grammar and such with in it are woefully inept and a major distraction. The quiz part has wrong answers in it as well. 

More to the point it’s an annoying disappointment to be asked for money in an app that is offering to help one study Gods word and grow closer to Him. 

Jesus never charged for his teaching and neither should Christian’s charge for things pertaining to helping people grow closer to Him. The Gospel is free to those who hear Gods calling. Freely we’ve received, and freely we are commanded to give. 

That said, the mechanics of the app are also clunky and not well thought out. I give it 1 stars only as an encouragement to the producers for the idea of helping others grow closer to God. I encourage them to put aside the pursuit of profit with this idea and store up treasure in heaven where it will last for eternity. God bless.

On another note I find it disingenuous that all the5 star ratings are of no substance and reek of padding the stats to draw people in. This alone is fodder for not getting this app. 

Sadly most people won’t see my post because it’s buried beneath a mountain of false profits. You’d be better served to open your Bible and dig in for yourself. There are many more study tools out there that help you grow without the ‘scaminess’ of this company.
